title: Epic Go-Live & Command Center Endpoint Readiness Playbook
author_notes: Derived from a Senior Endpoint Engineer (healthcare/Epic) requirement: support go-live and command center operations.

Scope: endpoint readiness + command-center operations playbook for an Epic go-live/upgrade/new-site activation — readiness criteria + validation sweep, go/no-go gate, command-center structure + dispatch, rapid day-1 fix runbooks, hypercare-to-steady-state handover. References the Epic-client/Imprivata/workstation solutions for deep config. White-label.
pricing: T3 (advanced) — operational readiness + event-management playbook spanning the fleet.
